content.body:
Some vehicles allow two players to work together allowing them to be much more effective on the battlefield. This screen will show you a list of vehicle commanders requesting another player and what their vehicle. Select one and press Select Commander to request to join that vehicle.
When two players share a vehicle, the Commander controls the movement and the joining player usually controls the weapons (turrets for tanks, gunner and bombardier positions for aircraft). How many positions are available to each depends on the specific vehicle.
content.title: Join Vehicle
